findings.title: Debug metrics DB row couples verification outcome into task_status_verified
findings.problem: After verification, the code inserts a row for the debug agent but passes verification_metrics.get("task_status") as the third argument to store_metrics_entry, which maps to task_status_verified in SQLite—mixing evaluator layers without documenting that join semantics for analysts.
findings.evidence:
_finalize_metrics(verification_metrics, verification_end_time - verification_start_time)
    store_metrics_entry(db_path, debug_metrics, verification_metrics.get("task_status"))
    store_metrics_entry(db_path, verification_metrics, verification_metrics.get("task_status"))
findings.suggestion: Rename column or split into verification_passed_int; document in metrics_db.py; or store debug row only with debug self-report status and use a separate column for verification outcome.
findings.impact: Downstream SQL that assumes task_status_verified reflects debug agent verification will misread benchmark data.

findings.title: Verification UNKNOWN collapses to verified=False in summaries
findings.problem: When main returns status None (verification token missing), success becomes False and verified is False because verified is derived from success when verification_metrics exists—conflating explicit FAILED with UNKNOWN.
findings.evidence:
success = result.get("status") is True
        ...
        verified = success if isinstance(verification_metrics, dict) else None
findings.suggestion: Map result.get("status") explicitly: True -> verified True, False -> verified False, None -> verified None; keep success separate for overall PASS/FAIL if needed.
findings.impact: summary.json and aggregates mislabel inconclusive verification as negative, corrupting verification-rate metrics.

findings.title: Preflight kubectl client check is not copied into run artifacts
findings.problem: Preflight runs kubectl version --client --output=json for availability, but cmd_run_single/cmd_run_many never persist that JSON (or server version) into run_config, so successful runs lack cluster/client identity in the audit bundle.
findings.suggestion: Return structured kubectl/docker/minikube facts from run_preflight and merge into run_config or provenance.json when tests execute.
findings.impact: Reproducibility gap for any issue filed against a specific kubectl minor version.

findings.title: No documented stochastic reporting standard for multi-run studies
findings.problem: Philosophy stresses reproducible fixtures and honest failure but does not define how to report variance across --repeat or multiple seeds (median, CI, pass@k), unlike industry eval hygiene referenced in the gaps doc.
findings.evidence:
### Test cases must be reproducible

Every test starts from the same broken state. This means:

- Setup commands in `config_step.json` must fully recreate the broken scenario from scratch
findings.suggestion: Add a short subsection on publishing results: minimum N, aggregation method, and forbidding single-hero run headlines; link to queue_summary.json fields once extended.
findings.impact: External readers may treat one noisy LLM draw as definitive.

findings.title: main.run() discards technique return payloads
findings.problem: The library-style run() helper invokes allStepsAtOnce/stepByStep/singleAgentApproach but throws away their dict results, making programmatic embedding of the harness harder and encouraging only CLI/subprocess use.
findings.suggestion: Return the same dict the techniques return (status, debug_metrics, verification_metrics) for tests and tooling.
findings.impact: Higher friction for golden-run or harness regression tests that call main.py directly.

findings.title: --validate-ground-truth ignores verification-agent settings
findings.problem: Validation loops call validate_ground_truth_config only; evaluator alignment (e.g. verification temperature per philosophy) is never checked, so misconfigured LLM evaluators ship undetected.
findings.suggestion: Add validate_evaluator_config or extend CLI to warn when verification-agent.temperature > 0.3 unless explicitly exempted.
findings.impact: Benchmark integrity drifts silently when configs contradict documented evaluator rules.

findings.title: No harness lock between chat models and embedder for fair sweeps
findings.problem: CLI_TO_CONFIG_MAP allows independent override of api-agent.model and api-agent.embedder; nothing warns when comparing chat models that one run changed retrieval and another did not, undermining multi-model study comparability.
findings.suggestion: Emit a warning or require an explicit flag when embedder differs from a recorded baseline; persist embedder + corpus id in provenance.
findings.impact: Model A vs B comparisons may attribute capability differences to retrieval changes.

findings.title: No benchmark flaky-test register or policy in operator docs
findings.problem: The agent loop documents how to read summary.json statuses but never defines a machine-readable flaky scenario registry (rate, last seen, owner) distinct from product CI quarantine—matching the taxonomy gap on benchmark flakiness hygiene.
findings.evidence:
3. **READ RESULTS** — Open `<RUN_DIR>/<test_name>/summary.json`  
   Check `status` (`PASS`, `FAIL`, `ERROR`, `TIMEOUT`), `verified`, `ground_truth_passed`, `error_message`, `error_context`.  
   If `status` is `PASS`, stop.
findings.suggestion: Add FLAKY.md or data/flaky.json plus guidance: benchmarks label flakiness and fix root cause rather than hiding failures; link to issues.
findings.impact: Intermittent K8s timing issues are indistinguishable from model regression in historical dashboards.
